data.name: result
data.shape: ProposalsResult — { actionable[], stale[], resolved[] } | empty | unreadable

data.name: problem
data.source: searchParams — the agree action's aftermath that needs the operator's eyes (a write that succeeded against an already-closed proposal)

data.name: note
data.source: searchParams — advisory: a decline that found the proposal already resolved; nothing was written

components.purpose: Everything a model has suggested for this account, and the standing promise that none of it has touched BattleGrid.
components.current_implementation: max-w-3xl centered column, space-y-4, p-6. The problem banner (danger, role=alert) and note banner (notice, role=status) render above the explainer — landed by a-bounced-agree-says-why.
constraints: The explainer sentence — a model can suggest but cannot make a change, nothing here has touched the account — is spec-adjacent copy and stays.

problem wears danger with role=alert; note wears notice with role=status — the mcp-control scenario 'The change was made but the proposal was already closed' forbids dropping either in a silent redirect.

components.purpose: The agree aftermath the operator must see — the account moved even though this page looks routine.
components.current_implementation: Danger role (rounded-gc-2 border-danger-default bg-danger-subtle p-4 text-sm text-text-primary), role=alert, message verbatim.

components.purpose: Advisory aftermath: nothing was written, and the operator should merely know.
components.current_implementation: Notice role, role=status; the known value renders in words ('This proposal was already resolved — nothing was written to the account'), unknown values verbatim.
constraints: Wears notice, never danger — nothing failed.

components.purpose: Three groups kept apart: waiting for a decision, went stale unread, already decided.
components.current_implementation: Sectioned lists in rounded-gc-2 border-border-default boxes; group headings at text-base font-medium. Unreadable renders its own heading plus 'this is not the same as having none'; empty says a model can suggest and none has.
constraints: Unreadable and empty must never be the same page — 'a failed read reported as an empty queue is the lie this product refuses everywhere else'.
Stale is shown, never deleted — 'a model suggested stopping this agent three days ago and nobody looked' must be findable.
Only an actionable row links; a stale or resolved row offers no way to open a describe nobody can agree to.

components.purpose: One proposal: what it would do, to what, when — and a link only if it can still be decided.

actions.effect: Actionable rows only: navigates to /pending/[id], which runs a fresh describe

components.current_implementation: flex row with border-t separators: operation label (underlined link when actionable), target, recorded-at timestamp in UTC, status suffix when not open.
constraints: The actionable/inert distinction must not rest on the link styling alone — inert rows carry their status in words.

components.current_implementation: Shared NotConnected component; treatment owned by DT-0006 on agent-archive-confirm.

flows.name: The aftermath returns here
steps: agree or decline on a proposal
redirect lands with problem= or note=
the banner says what happened before the queue renders

accessibility.notes: problem carries role=alert, note role=status. No client JS.
